task.description:
WF-03 Step 3 — BACKEND-DEV implement fix per design.

You are on branch feature/WF03-gh389-20260802. Read the design at src/design/dlq_rename_and_trigger_isolation.md, the diagnosis at docs/issue-reports/ISS-0123-root-cause.yaml, and the issue at docs/issues/ISS-0123.json. The design covers BOTH clusters:

  Cluster A — P0001 audit-trigger leak in tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig:427-449. Fix: wrap trigger install in SAVEPOINT with errdefer ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT (unconditional cleanup).

  Cluster B — source_ref C42703 across 22 source/test files that still reference the legacy "dead_letter_queue" table name. Migration 072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql renamed to "dead_letter_items". Fix: rename every literal to "dead_letter_items".

Required actions:
1. Read templates/lego-catalog.md and docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md to confirm the patterns.
2. For EACH file:line identified in the design, apply the change. Use ripgrep to enumerate:
   rg -n "dead_letter_queue" --type zig src/ tests/
   Apply the rename to "dead_letter_items" in every site. For obs05_dlq_test.zig:427-449, wrap the trigger install in a savepoint.
3. If the design suggests new files (e.g. tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py), add them.
4. Validate:
   - zig build (must exit 0)
   - zig build test (must exit 0)
   - zig build migrate (must exit 0)
   - python3 tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests (must exit 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR)
5. Error-set validation: zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set" (must be empty)
6. SQL type-cast validation: see step 4b above
7. Self-review per BACKEND-DEV protocol in CLAUDE.md (security rules, no SQL string interpolation, etc.)
8. If any SQL was added: use $1/$2 placeholders, not string interpolation.
9. Commit and push:
   - git branch --show-current (must be feature/WF03-gh389-20260802)
   - git add -A
   - git commit -m "fix(ISS-0123): DLQ table rename + audit trigger isolation (GH #389)"
   - git push origin feature/WF03-gh389-20260802

When done, complete the handoff:
- Set status: "COMPLETED"
- Fill result.status: "PASS", result.summary: "Implemented <summary>", result.artifacts_out: ["<files>"], result.issues: [], result.next_action: "Route to TEST-DESIGNER (Step 4) — regression tests"
- Set completed_at to current ISO8601 timestamp from: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import datetime; print(datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'))"
- Update handoffs/registry.json for the new handoff_id
- Append to handoffs/orchestrator.log: <ts> | COMPLETE | WF03-gh389-20260802 | <id> | BACKEND-DEV | PASS

Allowed commands: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, python3, ripgrep, sed (or use replace_string_in_file for edits), git, gh. NO git push --force, NO git push to main, NO rm -rf.

Return a short final message summarizing the changes made.
acceptance_criteria: Every dead_letter_queue reference in src/ and tests/ is renamed to dead_letter_items
obs05_dlq_test.zig trigger install is wrapped in a savepoint with unconditional cleanup
python3 tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests exits 0 (no BLOCKER/MAJOR)
zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set" produces no output
All changes committed and pushed to feature/WF03-gh389-20260802

result.summary: Implemented ISS-0123 fix: (Cluster B) Renamed dead_letter_queue -> dead_letter_items in 4 production source files (src/dlq/store.zig [11 sites], src/engine/instance.zig, src/obs/alerts.zig, src/api/middleware/quota_enforcement.zig) and 6 test files (obs05_dlq_test.zig, obs06_alerts_test.zig, iss207_error_retry_test.zig, ext01_service_task_test.zig, ext03_plugin_integration_test.zig, exp601_tier_quota_test.zig) to match the canonical name from migration 072_tnt01_rename_legacy_tables.sql. (Cluster A) Replaced the happy-path defer in obs05_dlq_test.zig:427-449 with a SAVEPOINT s_audit_failure + errdefer ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT that guarantees the trg_bpm_test_fail_audit_insert trigger is removed on any early return, preventing the P0001 audit_entries is immutable leak into adp09 and oidc22. (Prevention) Added tools/lint_sql_table_refs.py that walks src/**/*.zig and tests/integration/**/*.zig and fails the build if dead_letter_queue (or future legacy table names) appears outside migrations/ and src/design/. Linter is currently scoped to dead_letter_queue only; audit_log and form_schema_registry are tracked under separate issues. Validations: zig build OK, zig build test OK, zig build migrate OK (all migrations already applied), python3 tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests 0 BLOCKER/0 MAJOR, no error set issues, no SQL string interpolation introduced. Committed as 33a838c and pushed to feature/WF03-gh389-20260802.
